rationale.edition: Spans both editions. The complete changed-files list contains OSS paths (src/core/src/trial_quota.rs, src/synthetics/**, web/src/components/settings/OrganizationManagement.vue, web/src/components/synthetics/configure/*) alongside enterprise-owned paths (o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/cloud/billings/org_usage.rs, o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/metering/*, o2_openfga/src/meta/route_permissions.rs). The feature is a trial-quota/billing concern whose UI lands in OSS web/src, so edition is 'both'.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. Trigger comment is empty and no tests-added/opt-out label is present, so no explicit skip applies. The change is user-facing: the Organization Management settings page gains synthetics browser/protocol steps usage tabs and limit inputs.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The Organization Management page adds new UI (synthetics browser/protocol steps tabs, used/total readouts, and a set-usage-limit form with validation for whole-number/negative/max per the new translation keys), and the synthetics check configure components changed. This is a user-exercisable settings flow that needs verification.

There is no dedicated Settings/Synthetics folder in the playwright matrix, and GeneralTests is the catch-all shard already holding settings-adjacent specs (theme-management, languageTranslation, schema).
rationale.group: GeneralTests. This matches the chosen area and already exists as a testfolder in the ci-matrix (actual_folder GeneralTests), so the new spec can be appended to its run_files without creating a new shard.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs in the diff. The only test files changed are Vitest unit specs (web/src/components/settings/OrganizationManagement.spec.ts, web/src/components/synthetics/configure/CheckConfigure.spec.ts, web/src/services/organizations.spec.ts), which are not E2E coverage and do not set this flag.
